day4_night_start.name: {name}
day4_night_start.text: *I get home. A little park dirt and school dust cling to my sleeves.*

wall_seo_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_1.text: *10 PM. A call from Seoyeon. There's no laughter in her voice.*

wall_seo_pre_high_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pre_high_1.text: ...Can I be honest with you tonight?

wall_seo_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_high_2.text: *Seoyeon’s breathing is heard first through the cell phone.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1.text: *Seoyeon is silent. I need to be the one to reach out first.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1b.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1b.text: *I sent a text. 'Seoyeon, are you okay?' — One minute. Read receipt appears. No reply. Then — my phone rings.*

wall_seo_pre_low_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pre_low_2.text: ...I saw your text. Can you come out now? The park. — Sorry, it's sudden.

wall_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_2.text: Can you come out right now? The park. — Sorry, it's sudden.

wall_seo_to_park.name: {name}
wall_seo_to_park.text: *I left the house and headed to the park.*

wall_seo_3.name: {name}
wall_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon is sitting on a park bench. The ends of my makeup are a little smudged.*

wall_seo_6.name: {name}
wall_seo_6.text: *Sit next to me. Seoyeon is only looking ahead. The light from the streetlight hangs over the glasses.*

wall_seo_9_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_b.text: My family looks fine on the outside, right? Big house, nice car, student council president's daughter.

wall_seo_9_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_c.text: But Mom and Dad have been strangers living under the same roof for a year. They just haven't signed the papers yet.

wall_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_10.text: So at home and at school, I chose to smile. That was the easiest way not to get caught.

wall_seo_11.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_11.text: Mom said, 'If you fall apart, this house falls apart too.'

wall_seo_11_b.name: {name}
wall_seo_11_b.text: *Seoyeon presses her lips shut. As if swallowing.*

wall_seo_12.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_12.text: I was ten. — She said that to a ten-year-old.

wall_seo_13.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_13.text: Since then, I practiced smiling in front of the mirror. If my eyes did not smile, I did it again. And again.

wall_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_14.text: Every time they praised me, I'd think. — Even this smile is practiced. Did anyone ever really see me?

wall_seo_14_c.name: {name}
wall_seo_14_c.text: *Seoyeon stops speaking. Her hands clench on her knees. Before the moisture at the edge of her glasses can fall, she lowers her head.*

wall_seo_14_d.name: {name}
wall_seo_14_d.text: *Water runs from her eyes. Silently. Seoyeon starts to wipe it with the back of her hand, then stops, and just looks up.*

wall_seo_hug_choice.name: {name}
wall_seo_hug_choice.text: *Seoyeon is crying. The makeup on the back of my hand is smearing.*

wall_seo_hug_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_hug_1.text: *I hold Seoyeon. She buries her face in my chest. My uniform shirt gets wet.*

wall_seo_hug_2_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_b.text: ...It's been a really long time since I cried in front of someone.

wall_seo_hug_2_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_c.text: Eight years. All that time, I only ever cried alone in the bathroom.

wall_seo_hug_3.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_3.text: *Seoyeon's breath hits my shoulder in short bursts.*

wall_seo_pinky_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_2.text: When you want to cry, text me. I won't ask why.

wall_seo_pinky_4.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_4.text: ...Why are you like this. Why do you make promises so easily.

wall_seo_pinky_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_5.text: Everyone says that and then disappears.

wall_seo_pinky_5_b.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_5_b.text: *The pinky that sliced through air on the first day now hooks onto mine. Seoyeon's fingertip is cold.*

wall_seo_line_choice.name: {name}
wall_seo_line_choice.text: *Seoyeon is wiping her tears, looking up at me with trembling eyes.*
choices: I like this face too. Not the practiced one.
Not the council president — just Seoyeon. That's my girlfriend.
Honestly, I thought you were good at everything. Thanks for showing me this side of you too.

wall_seo_after_line_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_2.text: This face — it's a mess right now, isn't it? Makeup smeared, eyes swollen. — Is this really okay?

wall_seo_after_line_4.name: {name}
wall_seo_after_line_4.text: *Seoyeon smiles. Damp marks remain under the smudged makeup.*

wall_seo_after_line_4_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_4_b.text: ...I don't think I need a mirror today.

wall_seo_after_line_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_5.text: Being here without a practiced face feels all right today.

wall_seo_skin70_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_skin70_1.text: *Seoyeon extends her pinky first. She doesn't stop there. She takes my hand. Presses her lips to my forehead.*

wall_seo_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_skin60_1.text: *We sat side by side on the bench. Seoyeon quietly leans on your shoulder.*

wall_seo_skin60_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_skin60_2.text: ...Let's just stay like this a little longer.

wall_seo_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_1.text: *Walking home after seeing Seoyeon to her door. — I pass by the school.*

wall_seo_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_2.text: *The emergency light is on in the gym window. Someone is bouncing a ball alone. Jersey number 19 moves faintly in the darkness.*

wall_seo_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_4.text: *After standing behind the school for a while, I returned home. The gym lights linger inside my eyelids.*

wall_dain_pre_high_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_pre_high_1.text: ...Can we talk about something other than sports today?

wall_dain_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_pre_high_2.text: *Dain is quieter than usual. The end of the voice touches the floor.*

wall_dain_pre_low_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_pre_low_1.text: *Dain smiles. Her hand is pressing hard on the knee brace.*

wall_dain_2_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_2_b.text: *We're not supposed to be at school, right?*

wall_dain_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_3.text: just come lol! left the gym back door open!

wall_dain_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_4.text: *The dark gym, lit only by emergency lights. Dain is bouncing a volleyball alone. She's smiling harder than usual.*

wall_dain_6.name: {name}
wall_dain_6.text: Why are you at school at night?

wall_dain_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_7.text: I sneak in sometimes! For practice!!

wall_dain_8_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_8_b.text: *I toss the ball up. Dain jumps and — spikes it. The moment she lands — she grabs her right knee and crouches down.*

wall_dain_10.name: Dain
wall_dain_10.text: No, I'm fine!! Just twisted it a little, it's noth—

wall_dain_11.name: {name}
wall_dain_11.text: *Her hand gripping her knee has gone white. — It's not nothing.*

wall_dain_13.name: {name}
wall_dain_13.text: *Sits next to me without saying anything. Dain closes his mouth. The gym lights hum low.*

wall_dain_16.name: {name}
wall_dain_16.text: *Dain is making a face I've never seen before. Dain, not smiling.*

wall_dain_16_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_16_b.text: I had surgery, and the doctors — they were really careful with their words.

wall_dain_17.name: Dain
wall_dain_17.text: After surgery, the doctor drew a line on paper. 'Daily life' ends here, 'athlete' starts here. I don't remember much after that.

wall_dain_18.name: Dain
wall_dain_18.text: My mom was crying when we left the hospital. — I couldn't cry. It just hadn't sunk in yet.

wall_dain_18_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_18_b.text: It finally sank in — when I was cleaning out the gym lockers.

wall_dain_19.name: Dain
wall_dain_19.text: I didn't tell anyone. Not even my parents. 'Dain wouldn't be Dain if she couldn't play!' — I didn't want to hear that.

wall_dain_20.name: Dain
wall_dain_20.text: Every time someone at school said 'You've got so much energy!' — right here. ...I couldn't breathe.

wall_dain_21.name: Dain
wall_dain_21.text: today. When running around on a date. When I pretend to be bright next to you. My knees couldn't hold on.

wall_dain_22.name: Dain
wall_dain_22.text: — But if I show you I'm hurting too, then I've got nothing left.

wall_dain_22_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_22_b.text: *I sat down next to Dain. The court floor is cold. I said nothing.*

wall_dain_choice.name: {name}
wall_dain_choice.text: *Dain is clutching the volleyball, head down. Her shoulders are trembling.*
choices: ...I won't say anything. I'll just be here.
You can cry. You don't have to pretend to be cheerful. Not with me.
...Shall we get up together? Just one more time.

wall_dain_newdream_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_1.text: *I was just sitting next to him. Both are speechless. Only the tips of Dain's sneakers shake slowly.*

wall_dain_newdream_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_4.text: I'm waiting for when you want to talk.

wall_dain_newdream_5.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_5.text: *Dain looks at her hands resting on her knees. She clenches and unclenches her fists.*

wall_dain_newdream_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_6.text: It's really funny, isn't it? I've been on this court every day since I was 5... but now I have to think about other things.

wall_dain_newdream_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_7.text: But with you sitting next to me — the floor doesn't feel as cold.

wall_dain_newdream_8.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_8.text: *The ball has stopped outside the line. Dain sweeps her palm once over the cold floor.*

wall_dain_cry_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_cry_1.text: *Dain collapsed onto the court. She started crying, hugging the volleyball.*

wall_dain_cry_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_cry_2.text: *Dain lowers her head. Droplets fall one by one onto the empty gym floor. The ball sits still outside the line.*

wall_dain_cry_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_3.text: Alone, bandaging my knee every morning...

wall_dain_cry_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_4.text: I set it as my phone alarm. 'Smile today!!' it says...

wall_dain_cry_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_5.text: Every morning, I looked at that alarm and forced myself to smile in front of the mirror...

wall_dain_cry_6.name: {name}
wall_dain_cry_6.text: *Dain turns off his phone. ‘Smile again today!!’ disappears into a black screen. Only the gym lights flickered white until the crying subsided.*

wall_dain_lastspike_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_1.text: *I hold out my hand. Dain takes it. We both stand up. — I set the ball for her.*

wall_dain_lastspike_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_2.text: *Dain clenches her jaw and leaps — the perfect spike. The ball slams into the court.*

wall_dain_lastspike_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_3.text: *She grabbed her knee on landing — but she's smiling.*

wall_dain_lastspike_3_c.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_3_c.text: But it's funny, it's a little better.

wall_dain_lastspike_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_4.text: ...lol it hurts. But since it's a toss, it's a little better.

wall_dain_lastspike_4_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_4_b.text: *Dain looks around the court. The dark, empty gym.*

wall_dain_lastspike_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_6.text: — Thirteen years since I was five. Thank you.

wall_dain_farewell_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_farewell_1.text: *There is no exclamation mark. Dain puts down the volleyball and walks first.*

wall_dain_farewell_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_farewell_2.text: *I leave the gym with Dain. We pass by the back gate of the school.*

wall_dain_mention_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_1.text: You know what Seoyeon said to me? ...She didn't say anything. She just looked at me.

wall_dain_mention_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_2.text: If she'd said something, I could've fought back. When someone says nothing, it makes YOU feel like the bad guy.

wall_dain_mention_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_mention_3.text: *Dain pauses briefly. — Then starts walking again. With lighter steps.*

wall_dain_skin70_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin70_1.text: *Dain cries and falls into my arms.*

wall_dain_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin70_3.text: *My shirt is getting wet. Dain's hands grip my back tightly. She won't loosen her grip.*

wall_dain_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin60_1.text: *We sit on the bench by the school's back gate. Dain lies down on my lap without any warning.*

wall_dain_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_1.text: *I see a light in the library annex window. A small desk lamp.*

wall_dain_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_2.text: *It’s Yuna. sitting alone My feet stop in place. There was no message from Yuna today.*

wall_dain_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_4.text: *I walked past, pretending not to see. Made it all the way to the back gate, but the note in my hand is still folded.*

wall_yuna_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_1.text: *10 PM. A message from Yuna. 'School back gate. Come now.'*

wall_yuna_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_pre_high_2.text: *Yuna speaks directly instead of using a note. There is no paper in her hands.*

wall_yuna_pre_low_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_pre_low_2.text: *No words come out. Yuna doesn't ask again, either.*

wall_yuna_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_2.text: *The back gate light flickers. Yuna is standing beneath it. The book is open, but not a single page has been turned.*

wall_yuna_4.name: {name}
wall_yuna_4.text: *Yuna heads toward the library annex. Past her secret reading spot — deeper in. The basement archives. Between dusty shelves. Yuna pulls out an old envelope.*

wall_yuna_6.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_6.text: This. I got it a year ago.

wall_yuna_7.name: {name}
wall_yuna_7.text: *Letter in an envelope. — 'To Yuna. Sorry. Something came up that I couldn't talk about. — Junho Lee'*

wall_yuna_9.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_9.text: A senior who used to come here with me. — The only person I was ever close to.

wall_yuna_10.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_10.text: In middle school, I was invisible. Nobody in class talked to me.

wall_yuna_11.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_11.text: It was my first time as a senior. ‘I liked your writing’ — just because of that one comment, it felt like I was in the class that day.

wall_yuna_12.name: {name}
wall_yuna_12.text: *Yuna's sentences are longer than usual. Much longer.*

wall_yuna_13.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_13.text: One day he transferred. No contact. Just this letter.

wall_yuna_14.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14.text: The person who saw that I was there disappeared. I thought nobody would notice me again.

wall_yuna_14_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_b.text: For a year I came here alone. Hoping he'd left something behind.

wall_yuna_14_e.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_e.text: When you first came to the library.

wall_yuna_14_f.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_f.text: You felt too much like him. That's why I was scared.

wall_yuna_14_g.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_g.text: If I got close again, you might disappear too.

wall_yuna_15.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_15.text: *Lowering her head* ...That's why I deliberately acted cold. I thought if I pushed everyone away first, it would hurt less.

wall_yuna_16.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_16.text: But you came every day. Quietly. — Without disappearing.

wall_yuna_16_b.name: {name}
wall_yuna_16_b.text: *Yuna is holding her sleeve tightly. While I catch my breath, the spine of the book is pressed into my palm.*

wall_yuna_choice.name: {name}
wall_yuna_choice.text: *Yuna's eyes are slightly damp. The tips of her fingers holding the book are pressed white.*
choices: I'm not that senior. I'm me. But I'll still stay by your side.
Forget about him. The one in front of you right now is me.
...So you came to me because of him? As some kind of replacement?

wall_yuna_moved_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_1.text: ...At first, maybe. Maybe I was chasing his shadow.

wall_yuna_moved_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_moved_3.text: *Yuna lifts her head. Those aren't her usual half-closed red eyes. She's looking at me directly, unwavering.*

wall_yuna_moved_4.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_4.text: Now I see you. Just you.

wall_yuna_moved_5.name: {name}
wall_yuna_moved_5.text: *Yuna lets out a slow breath. The corner of the letter crumples a little under her fingertips.*

wall_yuna_moved_5_b.name: {name}
wall_yuna_moved_5_b.text: *Yuna lets out a slow breath. The fingertips clutching her sleeve tremble a little.*

wall_yuna_skin70_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_2.text: *She leans on my shoulder. She grips my hand tightly.*

wall_yuna_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_3.text: *Yuna's hand is warmer than I expected. — That's all.*

wall_yuna_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin60_1.text: *Between the shelves of the underground archive. Yuna presses her forehead against my back from behind.*

wall_yuna_sub_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_sub_1.text: ...Yeah. The senior is the senior. And you're you.

wall_yuna_sub_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_sub_2.text: *Yuna smiles faintly. Her fingertip presses the corner of the letter once more.*

wall_yuna_reject_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_reject_3.text: *Yuna turns away. She's walking fast. A bookmark slips from her pocket, but she doesn't pick it up.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_1.text: *I leave the school, leaving Yuna behind. Passing the front gate.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_2.text: *Under the streetlight in front of the school gate. Seoyeon was standing. I pick up my phone, write something, and then erase it. Write it again and erase it. The screen light only stays on the glasses.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_b.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_b.text: *Seoyeon puts the phone in her pocket and turns away. Her back is straight. Only the shadow beneath the streetlight wavers briefly.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_4.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_4.text: *After not being able to leave the back of the school for a while, I returned home. The cell phone in my pocket is quiet.*

day4_night_regret.name: {name}
day4_night_regret.text: *The sentence you entered remains in the chat window. The cursor blinks at the end.*

day4_night_regret_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_regret_msg_seo.text: The wind was nice today. So... I kind of hoped for something. For no reason.

day4_night_regret_msg_dain.name: Dain
day4_night_regret_msg_dain.text: Hey, today was fun haha ...I just hoped I wasn't the only one who got excited.

day4_night_regret_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_night_regret_msg_yuna.text: ...Today. I kind of hoped for something. That's why I ended up even quieter.

day4_night_regret_msg.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_msg.text: *The phone screen lights up. There's one line of text. The read receipt appears slowly.*

day4_night_regret_reply.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_reply.text: *I type a reply and delete it. A single consonant lingers in the text box, then disappears.*

night_homeroom_msg_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_1.text: *Text message* Manuscript's almost done. ...There's a part I'd like you to read first.

night_homeroom_msg_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_2.text: *Text message* If you have time tomorrow, come by the office. — After class.

night_homeroom_msg_3.name: {name}
night_homeroom_msg_3.text: *11 PM. A text from my homeroom teacher. Three short lines. — Those words, 'I'd like you to see it first,' keep lingering.*

night_nurse_msg_1.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_1.text: What you said in my office today... I keep thinking about it tonight.

night_nurse_msg_2.name: {name}
night_nurse_msg_2.text: *Read receipt appears. Ten seconds. Twenty seconds. No follow-up message. — One minute later.*

night_nurse_msg_3.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_3.text: Oh — I don't mean it like that. Just that you stuck with me.

day4_night_reflect.name: {name}
day4_night_reflect.text: *Saturday just flew by. Tomorrow's the school event. — Yeah, on a Sunday.*

day4_night_sleep.name: {name}
day4_night_sleep.text: *I close my eyes. Tomorrow is the last day. — There are still things left to say.*

day4_final.name: {name}
day4_final.text: *Saturday night is drawing to a close. Tomorrow's Sunday — the final day of the school event.*
